# Speccify 0.13.0

Speccify brings Specs, project knowledge, terminals and a configurable development
process into one workspace. Use your own CLI and account, keep your process in
the project, and share questions and results through its Git-backed Message Board.

## Choose your process

Configure the Specs collection with ordered steps, short column titles and colors.
Import methods from a Skills repository and pin the methods used by each step.
Start or continue a step deliberately from the Spec. Moving a card does not start
a CLI. Backlog can hold early drafts; review and recorded learning remain explicit
parts of the project's chosen process.

## One conversation across devices

Questions, claims, answers and review requests use linked Message Board threads.
The Spec keeps its context while another device reads and answers through the
shared Git register. Accepted answers can continue the same waiting local run;
saved conversation receipts prevent repeated delivery from repeating that handoff.
Review is tied to the submitted revision and evidence. A technical success does
not silently count as personal acceptance.

Paired devices can exchange bounded work requests for existing Command Actions.
The receiving device must explicitly allow the sender and exact action. This
first iteration accepts one request during a 30-minute allowance, without
variable inputs, and limits execution to ten minutes. Authenticated acceptance,
start and result posts return through Git. Re-delivery and restart retain the
execution record rather than starting the same request twice. Detailed output
stays local; publish selected evidence separately when it should be shared.

## A shared workspace

Drag resource tabs within and between Navigator areas. Split one editor to the
right or below, then return it to the main tab strip. Resource filter pills filter
the Navigator without opening a collection editor. A first project view provides
a Notes introduction and a Terminal. Existing saved layouts remain intact.
The terminal title overlays its full-height surface, and the optional text draft
supports mouse selection, cut and cursor placement before explicit transfer.
Help is available in English and German.

## Preserve existing installations

The regular package keeps the existing Speccify application identity, profile and
update channel. A new profile starts with the Process workspace. Existing or
uncertain full-app profiles keep their previous interface until an explicit,
guarded switch in **Settings → General → App interface**. The same setting provides
the return path. Open work and drafts can block a switch; saved resources and
additional screens remain available through the previous interface.

An accompanying compatibility package retains the separate identity and profile
of earlier Basic installations. It uses manual installation and has no automatic
profile importer. Choose the package matching the installed application; do not
replace an unrelated app merely because both Mac bundles are named Speccify.

Packages are published independently for macOS Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
Use the download page for the current availability of each platform.
